name: Divide Array
description: This keyword is used to divide the entire series /array of the selected instrument by a value. This keyword is used under the position keyword
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword is used to divide the entire series /array of the selected instrument by a value. This keyword is used under the position keyword

![Example](./images/img-1632143702.png)

The above example will divide  all the close values of the NIFTY 50 series by 10

parameters.name: Series
parameters.description: Nested series keyword to operate on, e.g. CLOSE(...), OPEN(...), HIGH(...).

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Value each point in the series is divided by.
